title: FemTheme Trio #016 · 여 바이올린 힙 아워글래스·천사 테마 / 여 V자 피지크·뱀파이어 테마 / 여 사이렌 바스트 아워글래스·마녀 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a maple avenue in full autumn colour with a pale path scattered with red and gold leaves, a standard park bench and lamp posts, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, THREE people standing close side by side, shoulder to shoulder in a single row, with just enough spacing that every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back far enough that all three are visible from head to toe, the whole row filling the width of the tall frame, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Thai woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, flawless pale-golden skin, sharply defined dark brows, a precise black winged liner with a strong flick, warm brown-bronze eyeshadow, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour under the cheekbones, deep red glossy lips with a crisp edge, a poised, dramatic expression, warm chestnut-brown hair styled in curly, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large silver hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a gold miniature anvil, an iron ship's anchor, a copper teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver hammer head, a lead chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long gold chain ending in one large faceted emerald drop with a heavy rough silver a cube-shaped block hanging at its end, and a single silver necklace. Extremely long square nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a sharply cinched waist rises out of hips that sweep outward in a single smooth violin-shaped curve, the hips and thick rounded thighs flaring many times wider than the waist and dominating her silhouette from the front and side, a firm high rounded rear, a full round bust balancing the curve above; the line from waist to hip to thigh is one long unbroken curve; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a thin golden halo floating above her head and a pair of large white feathered angel wings attached at her back, a tiny white satin micro-bikini top of two small opaque triangle cups on thin strings tied at the neck and back, fully covering her bust, and a minimal white satin micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme white platform stiletto knee-high boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

CENTER: ONE real adult Swedish woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, very pale, cool skin, a soft white-silver highlighter along the cheekbones, nose bridge and brow bones, pale icy-blue eyeshadow with a fine silver shimmer, pale softly brushed blonde brows, curled light-brown-tipped lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, a sheer frosted pale-pink lip, a cool, calm, faraway expression, vivid copper-orange hair styled in long locs gathered loosely, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a silver round bell, a gold ship's anchor, a lead barrel-shaped weight, a silver small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large silver hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a tin teardrop-shaped sinker, a gold ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered silver bracelets. Extremely long square nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
CENTER Physique: an extraordinarily tall and powerful athletic woman, far beyond any real person; wide capped boulder-like shoulders, a broad flaring back and lats forming a dramatic V-taper, defined muscular arms, a firm chest, a deeply defined six-pack abdomen on a very narrow waist, round firm hips and strong muscular thighs with a visible quad sweep and defined calves; hard clean muscle under glowing skin, not bulky like a bodybuilder, not thin; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
CENTER Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a long black cape lined in red silk, fastened at her neck and hanging open down her back, leaving the front of her body bare, a tiny black satin micro-bikini top of two small opaque triangle cups on thin strings tied at the neck and back, fully covering her bust, and a minimal black satin micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
CENTER Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.
CENTER Footwear: Extreme hot-pink ballet heels with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Hawaiian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a natural glowing complexion, a flower tucked behind one ear, warm golden-tan skin, vivid copper-orange hair styled in a layered tousled shag cut, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long rose-gold chain ending in one large faceted amethyst drop, and on the other ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a silver cube-shaped block, a gold small flared temple bell, a lead pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single gold anklet. Extremely long oval nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a tall pointed black witch hat with a deep purple band and a thin purple ribbon choker, a deep purple silk scarf folded into the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and knotted in a small knot at the side of her bust right beside one breast, one end of the silk trailing long down her side and the other end cut short, fully opaque and covering only what it must, and a minimal deep purple silk micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
RIGHT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme silver sculptural heels with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
